sourceOfTruth.scope: handwritten framework integration and dedicated renderer exceptions

exceptions.reason: The current React StatusBadge converts an open-ended status value through a variantMap into the Badge visual contract; schema v2 does not yet encode preset/transform aliases over another component contract.
evidence: StatusBadge delegates rendering to Badge and performs status-to-variant normalization before render.
exceptions.exitCriteria: Add a framework-neutral preset/alias transform contract that can express status-to-variant mapping, or deprecate StatusBadge in favor of Badge with an application-owned mapping.

exceptions.reason: These current React exports are named preset helpers over IconButton with fixed icon, variant, tooltip, and accessible-name defaults rather than independent canonical elements.
evidence: Each helper delegates to IconButton and supplies a fixed icon plus accessibility/visual defaults.
exceptions.exitCriteria: Teach canonical contract metadata/generation to express named presets over another component without handwritten framework branches, or deprecate the convenience aliases.

exceptions.reason: ToastAction is a React composition helper over Button used inside toast content and has no standalone canonical Custom Element tag.
evidence: ToastAction delegates directly to Button with toast-specific size/variant and altText accessibility semantics.
exceptions.exitCriteria: Represent toast action composition as a canonical named composition/preset contract that all framework facades can generate, or remove the standalone helper export.

exceptions.reason: ToastProvider combines React context ownership and timer orchestration around the toast viewport/service; schema v2 models component facades but not framework context-provider lifecycle.
evidence: The provider owns React context, pause/resume timers, and renders ToastViewport while the canonical native surface exposes viewport methods.
exceptions.exitCriteria: Define a shared framework-neutral toast service contract plus framework-specific provider/service bindings generated from it.

exceptions.reason: useToast is a React hook returning a context-backed ToastController service, not a DOM component; schema v2 currently models component facades and not framework service/composable bindings.
evidence: The hook reads ToastContext and returns the ToastController service API; it has no DOM renderer.
exceptions.exitCriteria: Add a framework-neutral service/API contract model consumed by React hook, Angular service, Vue composable, and Native imperative facade generation.
